assertions.title: CLICK-N01: adjacent Calculator buttons deliver each digit within the native click budget
DIFF-N01: ordinary Calculator diffs expose changing display text without actionable IDs
TAB-N01: same-title native tabs retain physical identity and emit selection changes before exact close
BUTTON-N01: one primary click opens a Safari tab when its native button omits AXPress
FOCUS-N01: app scope follows the focused document while the document handle stays exact
SHEET-N01: document handle edits and cancels its attached Save sheet
WINDOW-N01: a physical app window transition emits one AX cue after screenshot-only observation, while tabs do not
WINDOW-N02: exact document observation stays exact and emits no app transition cue after opening a sibling
AX-N01: one Safari reload applies once without opening an unrelated toolbar menu
FIND-N01: native app scope binds actual Find controls while the main document remains exact
KEY-S05: background paste refuses browser chrome focus without delivery
KEY-S04: named plus chords change zoom once on the exact owned Chrome window
ACT-N01: advertised native press keeps digit delivery and bounds auxiliary observation
CLICK-W01: Safari web text click retains focus settling and renderer input
CLICK-M02: native Maps text click avoids WebKit delay while preserving query delivery
FILE-N01: a native file label selects once without editable-focus failure and opens only on advertised Open
SELECTION-OBS-N04: Notes embedded editor selection uses its exact associated window and survives read-only observations
FORMAT-N04: normal diffs report same-editor bold and unbold without changing raw text
DIFF-N02: multiline editor diffs retain all text and never expose content as action rows
RICH-N01: rich html paste persists exact boundaries and bold style
RICH-N02: rich html paste persists exact boundaries and bold style
RICH-N03: rich md paste persists exact boundaries and bold style
PASTE-N01: pastes multiline text into the native document
PASTE-N04: preserves a competing copy after actual text insertion
SELECT-N01: replaces the disambiguated second occurrence after Unicode text
SELECT-N03: an ambiguous match preserves the established selection
SELECT-N-cursor_before: inserts at the requested edge without replacing the match
SELECT-N-cursor_after: inserts at the requested edge without replacing the match
TYPE-N06: long Unicode packets replace a selection and persist the complete multiline tail
FINDER-N06: clicking an already-selected filename preserves its collection behavior in list view
FINDER-N06: clicking an already-selected filename preserves its collection behavior in icon view
